Sharpest Spear

A game by NPJarcade, made in two weeks for LowRezJam 2026

( downloadable version is recommended! )

- CONTROLS -

WASD Move around
LEFT CLICKAttack
LEFT CLICK (hold) Drag inventory items
drag to heal / use flint
RIGHT CLICK (hold)Lock-on
auto-blocks while locked on
EGrab items
defeated enemies will sometimes drop items
SHIFTSprint
consumes stamina
TABOpen inventory / status screen
the game is not paused while the status screen is open!


- ENTER THE ARENA -

Keep your spear sharp... and your wits sharper

  • Your goal is to gain victory in the arena by defeating all who oppose you
  • You must gain the favour of the overlords.  KILLS = FAVOUR! 
  • If you are chosen, enter the beam of light to ascend into the arena where the true battle begins with a high level foe
  • Victory in the arena allows you to choose a perk/reward
  • If you take too long, the purge will begin.  Survive the purge and keep fighting until you are able to enter the arena


- TIPS -

  • You'll auto-block incoming attacks while locked on to an enemy
  • Keep an eye on your stamina - you can't block or attack when it reaches zero
  • Your max health is also your max stamina, so focus on healing to maximise your stopping power and chances of survival
  • If you're injured, enter the status screen [TAB] to heal, but be careful... foes may use this as an opportunity to strike while you're unaware
  • Click and drag hearts onto your character to heal 
  • You choose when you enter the arena, so make sure you're ready for a tough fight! 
  • Use flint to temporarily sharpen your spear (used in the same way as hearts)
  • You can loot defeated foes for useful tools to help you survive
  • Make sure to choose a perk when you've beaten the arena! 
  • Defeated foes may sometimes drop items.  Loot them by pressing [E] when the crosshair changes colour
  • You can sprint by holding [SHIFT]


- ABOUT -

This game is my submission for LowRezJam 2026.  Of ten optional themes I chose to create a game around the themes of 'Obey The Game Master' and 'You're Not Allowed To Win'.

The browser version can be a bit sluggish and has some graphical issues that aren't present in the downloadable verison.  If you're enjoying the game, I'd recommend the downloadable windows version for the best experience. 

Thank you for playing!

f44w13 days ago (1 edit) (+1)

Fun little game with simple yet effective pixel graphics and sound design that create a good atmosphere to get you into the feeling of fighting to survive in a brutal arena. Gameplay is similarly simple but fun, with some nice extra challenge of needing to enter the inventory and manually click and drag to use items - meanwhile enemies are not paused and are still trying to kill you. Though I would say that the group fight to be 'chosen' is often harder than the special 1v1 itself, since you can be outflanked and facing a lot of enemies at once, especially once the purge has started and you're in the later rounds requiring 10+ kills. Still a good time for a small game, love to see it :)

Very nice!!! Played it a few times and found it quite unnerving! I think the difficulty could get a bit spicier, though, especially in how the enemies feel in combat.

Maybe having enemies with different attack ranges and attack speeds could make encounters more interesting. For example, enemies with longer-range attacks could deal more damage but attack less frequently, while short-range enemies could deal less damage but attack in faster sequences with shorter intervals between attacks. That could make the player quickly adapt to different enemy types and approaches.

But I had a ton of fun either way, don't get me wrong!
